resources.name: cedefop-esi-json
resources.title: European Skills Index (ESI), 2024 methodology
resources.description: Cedefop's European Skills Index measures how well each country's skills system performs, as a composite of 15 indicators grouped into three pillars — skills development (basic education; training and other education), skills activation (transition to work; labour market participation) and skills matching (skills utilisation; skills mismatch). Scores are normalised from 0 to 100, where 100 is the 'frontier' of best achievable performance. The ESI 2024 dataset recomputes every release from 2017 to 2024 with the 2024 methodology. Time is the ESI release year; the release year equals the data year plus 2 (e.g. ESI 2024 uses principally 2022 data).
